subject: Renewal: payor transfer for expansion + invoice routing
messages:
From: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@bigwave.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kevin O'Connor <kevin.oconnor@bigwave.io>, BigWave Finance <ap@bigwave.io>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity expansion — payor change request

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. BigWave is ready to accept Redwood's upgrade quote (we're moving from 8k tokens to the 2x capacity reserved plan). Before we finalize the PO, legal asked if we can route invoices to a different payor entity within our org — Finance (BigWave Holdings LLC) will be the paying entity for the Redwood contract, not BigWave Analytics.

Two asks from our side so we can get the PO and payment set up: 
- Can you reissue the renewal invoice and quote showing the payor as BigWave Holdings LLC and the billing address below?
- We'll provide a PO once we have the payor name and tax info on the quote. Also confirm whether Net30 terms on the original SOW can be extended to Net45 for this renewal.

Billing details (payor):
BigWave Holdings LLC
1234 Harbor Drive
San Francisco, CA 94107
EIN: 12-3456789

I'll attach the preliminary PO when legal finishes their review. Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement is hoping to close by end of week so we can start the capacity increase on Sep 1.

Thanks,
Elena
Principal Program Manager
BigWave Analytics

Attachments: (will send PO PDF after legal sign-off)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@bigwave.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity expansion — payor change request

Hi Elena — great to hear you're moving forward. We can absolutely update invoice/payor details and confirm Net45 for this renewal. Quick notes and next steps: 

1) We will produce a revised quote and proforma invoice showing payor = BigWave Holdings LLC and include the EIN you provided.
2) Net45 is acceptable for this renewal provided the signed PO references the new payor entity and the PO is received before the renewal effective date.
3) Please have Finance attach an official W-9 for BigWave Holdings LLC (required by our AR team). For EU customers we'd ask for a VAT certificate; since this is US-based the W-9 is sufficient.
4) We'll need the official PO PDF and the authorized signer name/email to complete invoicing and set the billing contact.

I've looped in Marcus (billing ops) and Ben (account exec) to expedite. Marcus — can you prepare the updated quote/invoice draft and attach Redwood's W-9? Ben/Marissa — heads up on the planned Sep 1 capacity start if PO arrives this week.

I'll follow up with the revised document within 2 business hours.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (attached)

From: BigWave Finance <ap@bigwave.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@bigwave.io>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity expansion — payor change request

Hi Irene,

Attached is our official PO and signed cover page: BigWave_PO_87521.pdf. The PO references BigWave Holdings LLC as the paying entity and lists Kevin O'Connor as the authorized signatory (kevin.oconnor@bigwave.io). 

A couple of clarifying items for Redwood's AR team: 
- Billing contact for invoices should be: ap@bigwave.io (Accounts Payable team) and cc: kevin.oconnor@bigwave.io. 
- Payment terms requested on the PO: Net45 (please confirm).
- We have included the EIN on the PO but will also attach a W-9 as requested — sending that now.

Thanks,
BigWave Accounts Payable
AP Team | BigWave Holdings LLC

Attachments: BigWave_PO_87521.pdf, BigWave_W9.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: BigWave Finance <ap@bigwave.io>, Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@bigwave.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Updated invoice & next steps for capacity start (PO 87521)

Thanks for the PO and W-9 — received and validated. Per our internal checklist, everything needed to re-route billing has been captured. Actions completed and timeline: 

- I attached the updated quote and proforma invoice (Quote-Redwood-Upgrade-2026-08-22.xlsx) showing payor = BigWave Holdings LLC and EIN included.
- Invoicing terms updated to Net45 per PO — Redwood AR will issue the first invoice on Sep 1 for the committed reserved capacity and will send to ap@bigwave.io with cc to kevin.oconnor@bigwave.io.
- The account has been scheduled for the capacity increase on Sep 1; engineering will enable provisioning once the subscription record reflects the new payor entity (expected within 24 hours of PO posting).

Please confirm the billing contact email and that the PO number in your system is 87521 so we can close the loop. If all good, Ben will follow up on a short kickoff for the upgrade and migration window.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Quote-Redwood-Upgrade-2026-08-22.xlsx, Redwood_W9.pdf
